units.source_text: 不到一小时的工夫，传来了巡回演出艺人整装出发的声响。

en.t: In less than an hour, I heard the sounds of the traveling performers getting ready to leave.
I could no longer sit still.

units.source_text: 不过，只是内心纷乱如麻，却没有勇气站起来。

en.t: But my heart was only in turmoil, and I did not have the courage to stand up.

units.source_text: 我心想：虽说她们长期旅行走惯了路，但毕竟还是女人，就是让她们先走一二公里，我跑步也能赶上。

en.t: I thought to myself: though they were used to walking from long travel, they were women after all; even if I let them get one or two kilometers ahead, I could catch up by running.

units.source_text: 我身在炉旁，心却是焦灼万分。

en.t: My body was by the hearth, but my heart was unbearably restless.

units.source_text: 尽管如此，她们不在身旁，我反而获得了解脱，开始胡思乱想。

en.t: Even so, with them no longer nearby, I felt instead a kind of release and began to let my thoughts wander.

units.source_text: 老太婆把她们送走后，我问她：

en.t: After the old woman had seen them off, I asked her:
